property.confidentiality.message.title: Message confidentiality
property.confidentiality.message.definition: Message content is not disclosed to parties outside the explicitly identified recipient set.
assumptions: The protected information and intended recipients are explicitly identified for the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not prescribe a protocol, algorithm, key size, storage product, or recipient policy.

property.confidentiality.key-material.title: Key-material confidentiality
property.confidentiality.key-material.definition: Secret keying material and secret key metadata are not disclosed outside their explicitly authorized handling scope.
assumptions: The protected information and intended recipients are explicitly identified for the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not prescribe a protocol, algorithm, key size, storage product, or recipient policy.

property.integrity.message.title: Message integrity
property.integrity.message.definition: A receiver can detect unauthorized modification, insertion, deletion, or truncation of protected message content.
assumptions: The protected object and the state transition in which it is interpreted are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not establish origin authentication, availability, or correctness of the protected content.

property.integrity.state.title: State integrity
property.integrity.state.definition: Security-relevant communication state changes only through explicitly valid transitions and unauthorized mutation is detectable.
assumptions: The protected object and the state transition in which it is interpreted are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not establish origin authentication, availability, or correctness of the protected content.

property.integrity.configuration.title: Configuration integrity
property.integrity.configuration.definition: Security-relevant configuration is bound to an authorized value set and unauthorized change is detectable before use.
assumptions: The protected object and the state transition in which it is interpreted are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not establish origin authentication, availability, or correctness of the protected content.

property.integrity.transcript.title: Transcript integrity
property.integrity.transcript.definition: The ordered communication transcript used for a security decision is protected against undetected alteration or omission.
assumptions: The protected object and the state transition in which it is interpreted are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not establish origin authentication, availability, or correctness of the protected content.

property.authentication.peer.title: Peer authentication
property.authentication.peer.definition: A party can establish that the communicating peer has the intended scoped identity.
assumptions: The asserted identity type, relying party, and authentication direction are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property does not grant authorization, approval, non-repudiation, or trust outside its scoped context.

property.authentication.sender.title: Sender authentication
property.authentication.sender.definition: A receiver can establish the scoped origin identity asserted for a received message.
assumptions: The asserted identity type, relying party, and authentication direction are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property does not grant authorization, approval, non-repudiation, or trust outside its scoped context.

property.authentication.device.title: Device authentication
property.authentication.device.definition: A relying party can establish the scoped device identity participating in a communication.
assumptions: The asserted identity type, relying party, and authentication direction are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property does not grant authorization, approval, non-repudiation, or trust outside its scoped context.

property.authentication.service.title: Service authentication
property.authentication.service.definition: A client or peer can establish the scoped service identity intended for the communication.
assumptions: The asserted identity type, relying party, and authentication direction are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property does not grant authorization, approval, non-repudiation, or trust outside its scoped context.

property.binding.identity.title: Identity binding
property.binding.identity.definition: The asserted identity is unambiguously bound to the communication context in which it is relied upon.
assumptions: Every value being bound has an unambiguous representation and lifecycle within the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not define the encoding, protocol transcript, identity system, or session mechanism.

property.binding.role.title: Role binding
property.binding.role.definition: An asserted role is unambiguously bound to the authenticated identity and scoped communication context.
assumptions: Every value being bound has an unambiguous representation and lifecycle within the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not define the encoding, protocol transcript, identity system, or session mechanism.

property.binding.session.title: Session binding
property.binding.session.definition: Messages and security decisions are unambiguously bound to the intended session instance.
assumptions: Every value being bound has an unambiguous representation and lifecycle within the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not define the encoding, protocol transcript, identity system, or session mechanism.

property.binding.context-epoch.title: Context and epoch binding
property.binding.context-epoch.definition: Derived values, messages, and state transitions are unambiguously bound to the intended application context and epoch.
assumptions: Every value being bound has an unambiguous representation and lifecycle within the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not define the encoding, protocol transcript, identity system, or session mechanism.

property.binding.transcript.title: Transcript binding
property.binding.transcript.definition: Security decisions and derived values are unambiguously bound to the intended complete transcript.
assumptions: Every value being bound has an unambiguous representation and lifecycle within the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not define the encoding, protocol transcript, identity system, or session mechanism.

property.replay-ordering.replay-duplicat.title: Replay and duplicate resistance
property.replay-ordering.replay-duplicat.definition: Previously accepted or duplicated protected input is not silently accepted as a new authorized event.
assumptions: The receiver has an explicit state model for recognizing accepted message instances and transitions.
exclusions: This property does not require a particular counter, clock, window, transport, or persistence mechanism.

property.replay-ordering.ordering.title: Ordering integrity
property.replay-ordering.ordering.definition: Security-relevant inputs are processed only in an ordering allowed by the scoped state model.
assumptions: The receiver has an explicit state model for recognizing accepted message instances and transitions.
exclusions: This property does not require a particular counter, clock, window, transport, or persistence mechanism.

property.replay-ordering.freshness.title: Freshness validation
property.replay-ordering.freshness.definition: A relying party can distinguish input that is sufficiently current for the explicitly bounded use.
assumptions: The receiver has an explicit state model for recognizing accepted message instances and transitions.
exclusions: This property does not require a particular counter, clock, window, transport, or persistence mechanism.

property.replay-ordering.rollback.title: Rollback resistance
property.replay-ordering.rollback.definition: Persisted security state cannot be replaced by an older state without detection or an explicit recovery decision.
assumptions: The receiver has an explicit state model for recognizing accepted message instances and transitions.
exclusions: This property does not require a particular counter, clock, window, transport, or persistence mechanism.

property.randomness.nonce-uniqueness.title: Nonce uniqueness
property.randomness.nonce-uniqueness.definition: Values required to be unique are not reused within their explicitly defined key and context scope.
assumptions: The required uniqueness or unpredictability scope is explicitly defined for each generated value.
exclusions: This property does not select a random generator, nonce construction, probability bound, or algorithm.

property.randomness.entropy-assumptions.title: Randomness assumptions
property.randomness.entropy-assumptions.definition: Every security-relevant random value has explicit unpredictability, independence, and failure assumptions.
assumptions: The required uniqueness or unpredictability scope is explicitly defined for each generated value.
exclusions: This property does not select a random generator, nonce construction, probability bound, or algorithm.

property.key-management.derivation-conte.title: Key-derivation context binding
property.key-management.derivation-conte.definition: Derived key material is bound to its explicitly identified purpose, parties, context, and version.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.key-management.separation.title: Key separation
property.key-management.separation.definition: Key material authorized for one purpose or domain is not silently reused as authority for another.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.key-management.storage.title: Key storage protection
property.key-management.storage.definition: Stored key material and associated metadata retain their required confidentiality, integrity, and usage restrictions.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.key-management.rotation.title: Key rotation
property.key-management.rotation.definition: Replacement of active key material occurs under an explicit lifecycle transition without silent continued use of superseded material.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.key-management.revocation.title: Key revocation
property.key-management.revocation.definition: Material declared no longer authorized is rejected within the explicitly defined revocation scope.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.key-management.destruction.title: Key destruction
property.key-management.destruction.definition: Key material leaving its allowed lifecycle is rendered unavailable for further authorized or unauthorized use within the stated environment.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.key-management.recovery.title: Key recovery
property.key-management.recovery.definition: Authorized recovery restores only the scoped key material and state without silently expanding access or reviving revoked authority.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.downgrade-agility.downgrade.title: Downgrade resistance
property.downgrade-agility.downgrade.definition: An attacker cannot cause silent selection of a less protective option outside the authenticated policy and context.
assumptions: Negotiated or configured choices and their authenticated context are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not approve any algorithm or require a specific negotiation mechanism.

property.downgrade-agility.algorithm-con.title: Algorithm-confusion resistance
property.downgrade-agility.algorithm-con.definition: A cryptographic result is not accepted under a different algorithm, mode, purpose, or parameter context than the one that produced it.
assumptions: Negotiated or configured choices and their authenticated context are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not approve any algorithm or require a specific negotiation mechanism.

property.downgrade-agility.algorithm-agi.title: Algorithm agility
property.downgrade-agility.algorithm-agi.definition: A scoped implementation can transition between explicitly supported algorithm identifiers without reinterpreting data or bypassing policy.
assumptions: Negotiated or configured choices and their authenticated context are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not approve any algorithm or require a specific negotiation mechanism.

property.compromise-recovery.scope.title: Compromise-scope explicitness
property.compromise-recovery.scope.definition: The effects of compromised long-term, session, ephemeral, or derived secret material are bounded and documented by material type and time window.
assumptions: The compromised material, affected period, parties, and recovery event are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property is not universal and does not claim protection outside the stated compromise window.

property.compromise-recovery.forward-sec.title: Scoped forward secrecy
property.compromise-recovery.forward-sec.definition: Compromise of specified current long-term material does not expose protected past content outside the explicitly stated assumptions and period.
assumptions: The compromised material, affected period, parties, and recovery event are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property is not universal and does not claim protection outside the stated compromise window.

property.compromise-recovery.post-compro.title: Scoped post-compromise recovery
property.compromise-recovery.post-compro.definition: After an explicitly defined recovery transition and removal of attacker access, new protected communication can regain stated properties.
assumptions: The compromised material, affected period, parties, and recovery event are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property is not universal and does not claim protection outside the stated compromise window.

property.metadata-privacy.communication-.title: Communication-metadata privacy
property.metadata-privacy.communication-.definition: Scoped identities, relationships, routing context, and communication attributes are not disclosed beyond the stated observer model.
assumptions: Observable fields and the observer capability under evaluation are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not claim that all traffic characteristics or external observations are hidden.

property.metadata-privacy.observable-pat.title: Length, timing, and traffic-pattern privacy
property.metadata-privacy.observable-pat.definition: The specified message length, timing, frequency, and traffic patterns reveal no more than the explicitly accepted leakage.
assumptions: Observable fields and the observer capability under evaluation are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not claim that all traffic characteristics or external observations are hidden.

property.resilience.fail-closed.title: Fail-closed behavior
property.resilience.fail-closed.definition: Invalid, unauthenticated, ambiguous, or unsupported security input cannot silently produce an authorized success state.
assumptions: The permitted failure mode and the state from which recovery is evaluated are explicitly defined.
exclusions: This property does not set a service-level objective or guarantee recovery from every failure.

property.resilience.availability.title: Scoped availability
property.resilience.availability.definition: Authorized communication functions remain usable within a declared resource and attacker model, or fail with a literal non-success state.
assumptions: The permitted failure mode and the state from which recovery is evaluated are explicitly defined.
exclusions: This property does not set a service-level objective or guarantee recovery from every failure.

property.resilience.state-recovery.title: State recovery
property.resilience.state-recovery.definition: Recovery from interruption restores a consistent, authorized state without accepting stale, unauthenticated, or conflicting transitions.
assumptions: The permitted failure mode and the state from which recovery is evaluated are explicitly defined.
exclusions: This property does not set a service-level objective or guarantee recovery from every failure.

property.evidence-publication.classifica.title: Evidence-publication classification boundary
property.evidence-publication.classifica.definition: Publication preserves an explicit distinction among public-safe, private, and prohibited material and requires human publication authority.
assumptions: Evidence classification and publication authority are assigned before material is exposed.
exclusions: This property does not authorize publication, disclosure, risk acceptance, or release.
